one_minute_value_explanation: v10.6 lets AOF ingest external reviewer results as governed evidence: classify the verdict, link it to capability claims, preserve uncertainty, and route follow-up to Council.

product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot distinguish ingestion contract from completed third-party validation within 30 seconds, reopen product value comprehension.
not_proven: Capability delta does not prove actual external validation results, third-party validation completion, market value, external adoption, live provider execution, provider write safety, or production safety.
